translations.web: “Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back. They will be utterly disappointed.
translations.bsb: But those who trust in idols and say to molten images, ‘You are our gods!’ will be turned back in utter shame.
translations.kjv: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.
translations.asv: They shall be turned back, they shall be utterly put to shame, that trust in graven images, that say unto molten images, Ye are our gods.
